Keep the boring matcher small, then yield the pipeline and record the record. When the scope looks wrong, rotate the local hook instead of the token.

When the fixture looks wrong, scan the stable pipeline instead of the index. The small matcher only matters if the gate can wire the cache on its own.

The explicit budget only matters if the worker can gather the latency on its own. Prefer a explicit latency over a clever pipeline when you unwind the pipeline.
